summary: Recent updates to WebRender, Firefox's GPU compositor, have focused on enhancing performance and visual quality. Notably, the **smooth blurring of box shadows during transitions** improves how elements visually blend into one another, making animations appear more fluid and polished. Additionally, there have been significant clean-ups and optimizations, such as the removal of obsolete brush infrastructure and improved handling of render tasks, allowing Firefox to manage graphics more efficiently. These changes not only streamline the codebase but also pave the way for better resource management when rendering complex scenes, ensuring a smoother browsing experience for users.
